summary: Iteration 2 validation of Sanctuary. Backend: 40/40 pytest pass (14 prior + 26 new). New v2 tests cover /api/ready, security headers (X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-Request-Id), progress reporting + continue_listening reflection per X-Device-Id, notes full CRUD with strict device scoping (DEV_A cannot delete DEV_B's notes and vice-versa, cross-list isolation confirmed), highlights CRUD scoped by X-Device-Id, history with embedded testimony + DELETE clears, analytics events (kind=play_start increments testimony.play_count while kind=share does NOT), progress id mismatch → 400, search across all|title|speaker|category|language|verse|transcript, favorite persistence + favorite=true filter, transcript English upload + text extraction + invalid-language rejection (400) + non-PDF/mime rejection (415), and global _id leak sweep across categories/testimonies/testimonies/home/notes/highlights/history. Frontend (mobile 390x844): Home renders continue_listening card, notif toast (home-notif-btn), 8 Recently Added cards, long-press card → 'Added to queue' toast, tap card → /player. Player: player-favorite toggles, player-rate opens rate-sheet, player-sleep-timer opens sleep-sheet, player-action-Note opens note-sheet and Save produces 'Note saved' toast, player-action-Share opens native/web share, player-action-Highlight opens transcript overlay. Transcript overlay: English/Telugu toggle, A-/A+ font, long-press paragraph produces 'Saved to Highlights' toast (backend POST /api/highlights confirmed via cross-session server state). Library: all six tabs render (favorites/recent/downloads/notes/highlights/history), empty states show for notes/highlights/history in a fresh device (device_id scoping working — new browser session doesn't see previous session's notes/highlights). Favorites tab shows favorited testimonies. Downloads screen: storage-used shows '0 B / 34.36 GB' from real bytes. Settings: theme-light/theme-dark toggle, all six picker rows open (picker-rate/sleep/quality/tlang/font/alang) — alang required scroll into view due to bottom tab-bar overlap; opens correctly once visible. Search: live search returns 2 for 'peace', all 8 filter chips (All/Title/Speaker/Category/Year/Language/Verse/Transcript) present, search-clear resets input, nonsense query renders empty state. No _id leak in any endpoint. No RN red-screen errors. Only benign RN-web warnings: shadow* and pointerEvents deprecation (unchanged from iter-1). Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: 'App language' row sits under the bottom tab bar in the initial viewport and needs manual scroll-into-view before it becomes tappable. Playwright's default click intercepted the row's tap; user on a real device would need to scroll. Consider adding bottom contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior or extra bottom padding equal to tab-bar height on the ScrollView.

issues: ScrollView bottom padding does not clear the bottom tab bar for the last row (App language).

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent benign web-only warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from src/theme/tokens (shadows.elevated/glow) and app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx miniWrap wrapper. Also: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported… Falling back to JS-based animation.' Cosmetic on web preview.

action_items: (LOW) Add extra bottom padding (or paddingBottom = tabBarHeight + safe-area) to the Settings ScrollView so 'App language' row is not obscured by the bottom tab bar.
(LOW/optional) Migrate shadow* style tokens to boxShadow on web and move pointerEvents='box-none'/'auto' from props to style in (tabs)/_layout.tsx miniWrap.
(LOW/optional) Player rate label formatting cosmetic '1.×' quirk carries over from iter-1; special-case rate===1.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean layered architecture preserved (controllers → services → repositories → Motor); _id is projected out at the repo layer (verified via _id-leak sweep across 6 endpoints).
Device scoping enforced in every notes/highlights repository query — confirmed with cross-device CRUD tests (DEV_A vs DEV_B cannot see or delete each other's records).
Analytics play_start correctly increments testimony.play_count while other kinds (share, search) do not — verified with before/after GET.
History rows are returned with embedded `testimony` object (join at service layer), no _id leaked; DELETE clears returns {"cleared": n}.
Security middleware sets X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, X-Frame-Options=DENY on every response; X-Request-Id is always attached and exposed via CORS expose_headers.

config.py enforces os.environ['MONGO_URL'] and os.environ['DB_NAME'] (no default) — fails fast if missing. MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES honored (500MB default). Non-PDF mime is rejected (returns 415 for text/plain in transcript upload).
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL consistently; testIDs applied on every interactive element.
InputSheet/PickerSheet dismissal on web has no Escape-key handler — cosmetic testing friction only (tap outside/backdrop dismisses).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (minor UI scroll gotcha noted)

seed_data_creation: Regenerated /tmp/sample_en.pdf, /tmp/sample_te.pdf, /tmp/sample_te_v2.pdf via fpdf2 for transcript upload tests. Runtime test data uses X-Device-Id prefixes 'TEST-dev-a-*' and 'TEST-dev-b-*' with 'TEST_' body/quote prefixes and is deleted at the end of each test where owned by test devices; residual highlights created via UI long-press in a browser session live under an auto-generated device id in localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://sermon-stream-9.preview.emergentagent.com (API prefix /api). Run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v` — 40 tests covering iter-1 + iter-2 features. Sample PDFs regenerated in /tmp/ before running v2. Frontend testIDs match the spec exactly (search-filter-{All|Title|Speaker|Category|Year|Language|Verse|Transcript}, downloads-tab-{Downloading|Downloaded|Paused}, library-tab-{favorites|recent|downloads|notes|highlights|history}). Device id is stored in AsyncStorage / localStorage per browser session, so cross-session UI tests will not see prior device's notes/highlights — this is by design (X-Device-Id scoping) and NOT a bug. When testing library-clear-history, ensure at least one history entry exists first (POST /api/testimonies/{id}/progress).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions. Minor UX: 'settings-row-alang' overlaps the bottom tab bar on 390x844. Root cause is the Settings ScrollView not adding bottom padding equal to the tab-bar height + safe-area. Fix: add `contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 96 }}` (or read useBottomTabBarHeight) on the More screen ScrollView.
